newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle limited $112/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle limited $112/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Trading on slaughter steers and heifers was limited as practically all showlists sold out Tuesday, USDA said.
Few dressed basis sales steady. Buyer inquiry fair. Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered ( paid on hot carcass weights ).
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs - dressed basis 112.00.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1200 lbs - dressed basis 112.00.
